summary: Artificial Intelligence Technology Solutions Inc. filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 on September 23, 2026, furnishing a press release announcing RAD's third order from a recently signed national dealer. The order covers two RIO Mini systems and one AVA unit for a major construction equipment company in North Carolina, expanding the relationship's product mix to RIO 360, ROSA, RIO Mini and AVA. No special-situation transaction, price, stake, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock is disclosed. The filing is an ordinary current report; no deal terms apply. Watch for cumulative order momentum as a demand signal rather than an arbitrage event.
